signals_info.description: Applicable road speed limit at the vehicle's current position.

nl_Literal_translation_en: At all times, the ego vehicle speed shall be less than or equal to the applicable speed limit.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 在所有时刻，自车速度应小于或等于当前适用限速。
nl_Paraphrase_en: At all times, the vehicle shall not exceed the applicable speed limit.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 在所有时刻，车辆不得超过当前适用限速。
